metaDescription: Enquire, visit campus, and join Lawrence High School ICSE, HSR Layout — from Kindergarten to Grade 10.

hero.title: Begin with a conversation.
hero.lede: Lawrence High School ICSE, HSR Layout welcomes families from Kindergarten to Grade 10. Start with an enquiry, visit campus, and we will walk you through the rest.

stages.title: Kindergarten
stages.text: Curiosity begins here — a gentle first year of play, language, and belonging.

stages.title: Primary School
stages.text: Strong foundations in reading, writing, number sense, and classroom confidence.

stages.title: Middle School
stages.text: Exploring, questioning, and creating — with growing independence.

stages.title: High School
stages.text: ICSE preparation for tomorrow, with character and leadership alongside academics.

steps.title: Enquire
steps.text: Share your child’s age or grade and a little about your family. Use the form on this page or call the admission helpline.

steps.title: Visit campus
steps.text: Walk the classrooms, labs, and grounds. Meet coordinators and see how a Lawrence day feels.

steps.title: Interaction
steps.text: An age-appropriate conversation or observation helps us understand your child and answer your questions.

steps.title: Documents
steps.text: If a place is offered, we collect the records listed below so joining is smooth.

steps.title: Confirm your place
steps.text: Complete the fee formalities shared by the office. We then welcome your child into the Lawrence community.

feesNote: Figures for the current academic year are shared by the admissions office during your campus visit, or on the helpline. We do not publish last year’s numbers here so families always receive the latest schedule.

fees.name: Admission fee
fees.covers: One-time joining fee for a new student.

fees.name: Tuition
fees.covers: Teaching, campus facilities, and the school-day programme.

fees.name: Transport
fees.covers: Optional school bus on available routes.
fees.when: If opted, with the transport desk

fees.name: Books & uniform
fees.covers: Issued through school vendors at the start of the year.

documentsBody: Bring originals for verification. Photocopies can be submitted after a place is offered.
documents: Aadhaar of the child and parent, as applicable
Address proof of the parent or guardian
Transfer certificate from the previous school (Grade 1 and above)
Latest report card, if transferring mid-stream
